name: 03A | Commercial Gate | Create & Email Stripe Payment Link

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const id=String(body.onboarding_id??'');if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id))throw new Error('A valid onboarding_id is required');return[{json:{onboarding_id:id}}];

parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS onboarding_id,c.display_name AS client_name,c.primary_contact_name,c.primary_contact_email,d.name AS engagement,d.value_cents,d.currency,pr.stripe_payment_link_id AS existing_link_id,pr.payment_url AS existing_payment_url,pr.sent_at AS existing_sent_at FROM app.onboardings o JOIN app.clients c ON c.id=o.client_id JOIN app.deals d ON d.id=o.deal_id LEFT JOIN app.payment_requests pr ON pr.onboarding_id=o.id WHERE o.id=$1::uuid AND o.status='RECEIVED' AND d.value_cents>0;

parameters.jsCode: if(!$json.onboarding_id)throw new Error('Onboarding is unavailable, already advanced, or has a zero amount');if($json.existing_link_id)return[{json:{...$json,reused:true,payment_url:$json.existing_payment_url}}];const currency=String($json.currency??'USD').toLowerCase();const form={currency,unit_amount:String($json.value_cents),'product_data[name]':String($json.engagement),'metadata[onboarding_id]':String($json.onboarding_id)};const price_body=Object.entries(form).map(([k,v])=>`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`).join('&');return[{json:{...$json,reused:false,price_body}}];

const ctx=$('Prepare Stripe Price').item.json;if(!$json.id)throw new Error('Stripe did not return a price ID');const form={'line_items[0][price]':String($json.id),'line_items[0][quantity]':'1','payment_intent_data[metadata][onboarding_id]':String(ctx.onboarding_id),'payment_intent_data[metadata][source]':'client_onboarding_os','metadata[onboarding_id]':String(ctx.onboarding_id),'after_completion[type]':'hosted_confirmation','after_completion[hosted_confirmation][custom_message]':'Payment received. Your agreement will be emailed shortly.'};const link_body=Object.entries(form).map(([k,v])=>`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`).join('&');return[{json:{...ctx,stripe_price_id:String($json.id),link_body}}];

const ctx=$('Prepare Stripe Link').item.json;if(!$json.id||!$json.url)throw new Error('Stripe did not return a payment link');return[{json:{...ctx,stripe_payment_link_id:String($json.id),payment_url:String($json.url)}}];

const subject=`Payment request — ${$json.client_name}`;const encodedSubject=`=?UTF-8?B?${Buffer.from(subject,'utf8').toString('base64')}?=`;const amount=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:String($json.currency??'USD')}).format(Number($json.value_cents)/100);const html=`

PAYMENT REQUEST

Let’s begin your engagement.

Hello ${$json.primary_contact_name},

Please submit the ${amount} payment for ${$json.engagement} using Stripe’s secure checkout.

Pay securely with Stripe

After payment, your agreement will be emailed automatically.

`;const mime=[`To: ${$json.primary_contact_email}`,`Subject: ${encodedSubject}`,'MIME-Version: 1.0','Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8','',html].join('\r\n');const raw=Buffer.from(mime).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');return[{json:{...$json,raw}}];

parameters.query: WITH payment AS (INSERT INTO app.payment_requests(onboarding_id,stripe_price_id,stripe_payment_link_id,payment_url,amount_cents,currency,recipient,status,sent_at) VALUES($1::uuid,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'sent',now()) ON CONFLICT(onboarding_id) DO UPDATE SET sent_at=now(),updated_at=now() RETURNING onboarding_id,payment_url,sent_at), delivery AS (INSERT INTO app.email_deliveries(onboarding_id,purpose,recipient,provider_message_id,status,sent_at) VALUES($1::uuid,'payment_request',$7,$8,'sent',now()) RETURNING provider_message_id), audit AS (INSERT INTO app.audit_events(onboarding_id,event_type,title,detail,actor_type,actor_name,metadata) VALUES($1::uuid,'payment.request_sent','Stripe payment request sent','A client-specific Stripe payment link was emailed through Gmail.','integration','Stripe + Gmail',jsonb_build_object('payment_link_id',$3,'payment_url',$4,'provider_message_id',$8,'recipient',$7)) RETURNING 1) SELECT payment_url,sent_at FROM payment;

options.queryReplacement: ={{[$('Build Payment Email').item.json.onboarding_id,$('Build Payment Email').item.json.stripe_price_id??'reused',$('Build Payment Email').item.json.stripe_payment_link_id??$('Build Payment Email').item.json.existing_link_id,$('Build Payment Email').item.json.payment_url,$('Build Payment Email').item.json.value_cents,String($('Build Payment Email').item.json.currency).toUpperCase(),$('Build Payment Email').item.json.primary_contact_email,$json.id]}}
